english: Unyuu~ I'm still so embarraaassed~.\nBut I wanna do somethin' about it~!
What should I dooo~?\nUnyunyunyu~!
(Wh-What's that!? I heard a weird voice and came to check...\nbut someone like me lendin' an ear probably wouldn't be welcome...\nI'll slip away unnoticed...)
*crack*\n(Wh-Why'd I have to step on a branch\nat a time like this! My luck...)
Kya! Wh-Who's there~!?\nI know you're behind\nthat tree~!
If you don't come out...\nI'll wrap my magical yo-yo's string around your neck\nand take you for a 'Servant Walk'~!
W-W-Wait, hold on~\nSorry, sorry, sorry,\nyou looked troubled so I didn't want to bother you.
Oh~ I totally thought you were\nmy stalker or a paparazzo~.
(If it HAD been a stalker or paparazzo,\nwould they have gotten the 'Servant Walk' treatment!?)
Hm? Did you say somethin'~?\nBut you overheard a maiden's troubles, didn't you~?
Since you heard it,\nyou're helpin' me out~!!
(Um, sayin' I heard nothin' doesn't look like it'll fly.)\n...Okay, if there's anythin' I can do...
Yay~!\nThis request is so embarrassin',\nI didn't know what to do~.
Um, well,\nyou already heard, but let me say it again...
(Aaaah, now there's definitely no escapin',\nno escapin', no escapin'...)
...I... actually... am~.
Yes?
I'm tellin' ya, I...\nin the future I wanna become a...~!!
Um, I couldn't hear the important part...
Geeez!!\nAn I-D-O-L~!!
You've been listenin' this whole time\nand teasin' me, haven't you!?\nGeez, that's mean~.
Sorry, sorry, sorry...\nbut, an idol... you mean those people who sing and dance?
That's right~. A little while ago, there's this\nclassmate of mine, Maron-chan,\nand she said she's gonna become an idol~.
At the time I was like, what are you even\nsayin'~, but then...
Lately I've been thinkin' that might be okay too...\nand I kinda wanna be one...
Kyaaa, so embarrassin'~!\nKeep this a secret or\nI'll hit you with the 'Attic Trapeze'~.
...Understood.\nThere's a ton to poke fun at, but I'll accept it all at once.
Gettin' caught thinkin' about how to become\nan idol, what it takes to be an idol...\nso careless of me~.
(Sorry, but you just told me all of that yourself...)
Hey?\nDo you think I... could become an idol~?
R-Really~?\nI'm gettin' a little confident!!
If there's anythin' I can help with, I'll do anythin'...\n(There's probably nothin', though...)
Thank you~\nI'm glad I talked to you~.
Wh-Wh-What are you sayin'~?\nThat's gross~.
Sorry, sorry, sorry,\nit just makes me sad hearin' about a pure-type idol\nhavin' a kid and gettin' married...
Uwaah...\ngross in so many ways~...
When you eavesdropped I was gonna torture you\nwith the 'Hell Swing', but talkin' about it\ncleared my head~.
But this is\n'just between us'~!!
If this ever comes up from someone else...
You'd better be ready~!!\nEhehe.
S-So cute~\nI want this\nfor my collection~.
Ah, wait, don't run!!\nYou're so fast~. Geez, it's all bashful~.
(Don't engage, don't engage, don't engage...\nAh, it's lookin' this way... pretend I didn't notice...)
Hey, why're you ignorin' me~?\nDidn't you see a cute creature\npass by over there~?
Sorry, sorry, sorry,\na cute creature?\n...I was lookin' down as I walked, so I didn't notice.
Geez, you're useless~. And\n'hope doesn't fall from just lookin' down!!'\nmy teacher always says~.
That such a cute creature\nexists... it's gonna revolutionize\nthe pet industry~.
Um, by the way, what did it look like?
Let's see~, it's about 30cm long and all slimy,\nwith four wings~. And tons of cute\ntentacles comin' out of its mouth~. Kuuu~.
At first it was wigglin' around on the ground,\nthen suddenly it spread its wings and flew off~.
And it flew off sprayin' a mysterious liquid\naround — there's nothin' cuter~.
(Just listenin' is makin' me feel sick...)
And then,\nwhen I tried to catch it,\nit fluttered off... huh...!?
Ah!! It's on your back~!!
Unya~, sorry~, my mistake.\nLife ain't that sweet~.
Phew, good thing it wasn't there...
But what were you panickin' about~?
Wh-Wh-What are you sayin'~?\nTryin' to ride on this creature's cuteness...\nunforgivable~.
Sorry, sorry, sorry,\nI got carried away...
But even though it looks similar,\nit seems to be a different creature, so\nI don't want either one~.
But Purichisa, though not as much\nas the earlier one, looks like it's\ntryin' to lay some kind of egg~.
Huh? So there IS somethin' there!?\nUm, could you get it off me?
No way~. Touchin' a guy is\nforbidden for an idol~.\nHandshakes only, that's the rule!!
No, that's not what I'm talkin' about...
Kya! You've got the same vibe as those gross\nweirdos who brag about havin' their eye\non junior idols~.
'I'll support you till you make it big,\nbut once you're famous, I don't know you!!'\nI don't want irresponsible fans like that~.
...Sorry... I'm feelin' kinda faint...
Wantin' private photo sessions,\nwantin' me to wear lewd swimsuits...\nTV is scary~.
And if your reactions in the boiling bath\naren't good you can't survive...\nbein' an idol really is a tough road~.
Huh?\nWhere was I headin' again?
Honestly! How deplorable~!!\nShe does it best~.
(I don't wanna get involved, but\nthis feels dangerous if I don't say somethin'...)
Um... what's wrong?
Perfect timin'~!! So, listen,\nthere's an idol group I love~!!
They're not as cute as me, but they gathered\n4,989 sorta-cute girls\ninto a group~.
...Huh? 4,989!?\nWh-What kind of number is that!?
You don't know? SicHack~,\nthat super-popular idol group!!
They're the popular group that does\nmixed martial arts in an underground arena\nto win the center position~.
Pretendin' you don't know won't work~.\nWho's your oshi~? Obviously\nMegu-chan of commando sambo~?
Or maybe you like Matilda-chan,\nthe center who wields dark dancing~?
Um, I have no idea what any of that is...
Fine~. But my number-one oshi,\nYoko-chan the Ryukyu karate user, never\nrises above trainee, and that bugs me!!
She learned a foreign martial art\nand works so hard, but for some reason\nshe just isn't popular~.
Her hair's this avant-garde afro you don't see\nanymore, she's got a special sentence-ender,\nand she's ultra airheaded.
Geez, why doesn't anyone\nnotice how cute she is~!
Um, your cuteness standards...\nfeel the same as with that creature last time...
That's it!!\nLet's go cheer at a SicHack\nconcert together~.
And buy Yoko-chan's merch\nas an offering~.
No way~!!\nI won't allow Yoko-chan to be looked at\nwith dirty eyes~.
Then what should I do?
Hmm, I'll buy\nthe merch for you,\nso just leave the money here~.
That's right~.\nNow that she's an idol,\nI want her to work hard on her own~.
...Sorry,\nsomeone like me ran his mouth...
Thank you~!\nMore than anythin', I'll become an idol too\nand stand on the same stage as Yoko-chan~.
(Why is it...\nthat I react to the word 'idol'...)
Speakin' of idols,\nthere's one among the people travelin' with us~.
That's right,\nI haven't really talked to her...
To become an idol...\nI could ask her... but I can't~\n...it's embarrassin'~.
Okay, like this, then like that...
Heeey, whatcha doin'~?
Yes! I've studied up on that\n'how to become an idol' thing you asked about!!
Hanya~! Thank you~.\nHow do I become an idol~?
...Yes, it turns out there are\nmany ways to become an idol...
Unyunyu~!\nTell me, tell me~!!
Orthodox-wise, there's the pattern of gettin' scouted\nat the downtown Omote-Nido crossing, and the pattern\nof switchin' from voice actin' or modelin' to idol.
Also, as extras: taggin' along to a friend's audition\nand gettin' picked yourself, or havin' your parents\nor siblings enter you without askin'.
I see~.\nI dunno where Omote-Nido is, but\nI hear stories like that a lot~.
This time, I thought about\nthe gettin'-scouted pattern.
Um, I'm terribly sorry, but...\ncould you try doin' it like\n○□△○○□△, kinda like that?
Ehh, but THIS is\nthe gettin'-scouted pattern~?
...Yes, that's what it says\nin the tomes I researched.
Um~, I... just came\nfrom the countryside~.
I don't know right from left,\nbut could ya tell me where there's a real tasty\ncoffee shop around here~.
Dunno~?\nIt's true what they say, city folk are harsh\non country bumpkins~.
I... shall become a leader who purges\nthe likes of them~!!
........., um,\nwhere in this do I get scouted~?
Accordin' to the literature, a farmer's daughter\nfrom the countryside got scouted and became an idol\nthrough goddess-like deeds on the battlefield.
Um, come over here a sec~.
What do YOU think\nan idol is~?
Ugh... I feel like that's not entirely wrong, but...\nI'll study a bit more~...
Sorry... I'll try a little harder!!
Unyaaa! You've only got biased knowledge~!\nIdols are way more noble~!\nAnd thinkin' about swimsuits at every turn is gross~.
Uuu, I thought I tried hard...
Anyway, I want you to think of\na different way to become one~.
But goin' out a little to get scouted\nsounds fun~♪
Hm? Come to think of it,\nYoko-chan said she got\nscouted at a boxing gym~.
If I did my magical yo-yo\naround the toy makers in Asakusa,\nwould I get scouted~?
Okay, so here it's like this...\nbut... over there's that thing, so...
Heeey, what's up~?
Sorry, learnin' from last time's failure,\nthis time I looked into the pattern of makin'\na pit stop before switchin' to idol!!
Unyu~, I already\nfeel like I don't wanna rely on you~.
Um, what's what~??
First, do various vocal exercises\nto become a voice actor~.
Next, go to beauty salons\nto become a model~.
And finally, to win over\nthe producer...
Hole up in the mountains for a month\nand gain the strength to fight bears...\ncomplete...~!?
Um, what IS this~!?\nThis no-good plan!!
Uuuuu, sorry,\nan ancient game console said that to become an idol\nyou get close with someone called a producer, but...
I thought you'd also need the ability to stand up to\nthe industry's corrupt side, so I mixed in 'How to Become the Strongest Warrior'.
Unyanyanya~, you probably\ndon't need that last part~.
But I think voice actin' is a wonderful job too~.
Becomin' all kinds of anime and movie characters,\nisn't that wonderful~?
Ugh... if I try, I-I can do it~.\nUm,\n'B-Big bro, wake up already~'.
'But we're not really siblings,\nso we can get married~!'\n...H-How was that~?
Fufufu, be amazed at my hidden talent~!\n'Hold it in~! I can't let you\nthrow your whole life away...~'
'Just doin' (killin') ain't\nthe way of carnage~'.
Um, those are some old-fashioned roles...\nbut with that much skill,\nyou might shake up the voice-actin' industry!
Unyu~,\nit could really happen~.
I hear voice actin' is a harsh world~.\nBut goin' from there to idol\nis totally an option~!!
By the way, what kind of anime do you like?
Hmm, I love stuff like that SF mystery where\nsea creatures turn into girls and plot\nto invade the surface~.
S-Sounds like a work\nwith a grand spectacle feel to it...
Kyun-kyun♪ Kyun-kyun♪\nMy boyfriend's a lefty~♪\nSpinnin' around and launchin' off...♪
(Wh-What's got her in such a good mood...\nbut, y'know, let sleepin' dogs lie...)
Hmm, put THAT in~.\nAnd... a little of this~.
Ouch! I burned myself~.\nWaaah, waaah, waaaah... *glance*.
(Ugh, she's noticed me...)
A-Are you okay?
Ehehe, you saw me~.\nI felt like I should at least be good at cookin'\nbefore becomin' an idol~.
So there's this senior at school, Aryutta-chan,\nand I'm makin' her specialty dish\nright now~.
So... I'd like to ask you\nto taste-test it~.
Bzzt! I don't like the sound of that~.
If it doesn't taste good, tell me\nit doesn't taste good~!
Wishy-washy guys get hated~.\nFine, no taste-test, just eat it~.
S-So cool~!\nThat's the 'no men in the kitchen' thing~.
Don't bother taste-testin',\nbring me the finished dish —\nthat's what grandpa always said~!
Alright! I'll do my best~.
Ta-da, it's done~!
Um, it's called the 'My Beloved,\nIn My Hands Bowl'~.
Mince the eight-eyed anglerfish lurkin' 4,000m deep and\nthe boar-bear that only lives in snowy lands, take broth\nfrom the Cemetery Claw that handles sky burials...
...Sorry,\nhearin' the details is makin' it hard to eat...
Well, anyway,\nit's a super-nutritious bowl made\nfrom precious ingredients~!!
Let's dig in~.
Sigh... well, then...
Excited excited excited...~.
*munch*... wh-what is this!!
It taaastes hooorriiible!!
*thud*
Huh? No good? That's weird~.\nAryutta-chan said if you eat this,\nit's a one-hit KO...
Ahh!! So THAT'S what she meant\nby one-hit KO~.
Aha, aha, ahahahaha.
(...Last time was awful...)
(Maybe I really shouldn't get involved\nwith women... it's 'cause J-san\nsays weird stuff...)
*Ting!!* Huh!?\nI feel eyes on me... th-this is...
Uuuu,\nsorry about last time~.
Ugu, ugu,\nbut, but, but~.
(Bad, this is bad — I heard somewhere that\nwhen a woman cries there's nothin' you can do!)
Wh-Wh-What's wrong?
Listen, I'm bad at singin', bad at cookin' —\nI can't become an idol like this~.
Huh? A natural airhead idol?\nBein' bad at everythin' is my strong point~?
The aim is makin' people want to protect me...\nit feels kinda calculatin', but...\nit tickles my heart somehow~.
Ugyaa, you're a gross person~.\nWhy would you say stuff like that~\nStay away from me~.
But to keep my distance from people like that,\nI gotta become an idol~.\nAlright! I'll do my best~.
Wh-...that's good~.\nIt means the hope of aimin' to be an idol\nis still there~.
Th-Th-That's right... phew~.
Alright!\nI'll do my best~.
Somehow, I've been\nrelyin' on you a lot~.
Me... relyin' on someone...\nunbelievable~.
This feelin'...\ncould it be...?
N-N-Nothin'~!!
Oh, oh, parent-and-child bowl...\nI mean, good night~!!
...Wh-Where is this!?
I've been waitin'~.
I invited you,\nbut did you forget~?
After shootin' through my heart...\nyou're so mean~. Kya.
(Wh-What!? That's how things were!?)
But I'm happy you came~.
Once I become an idol,\nlove becomes a scandal~.
So at this school festival,\nI'll tell you all my feelings~.
Now! Into the classroom~.
H-How is it~?\nI won't show the other customers~.
Because today I decided\nto be your idol and yours alone~.
I had this outfit made new just for you~.
Geez, if you say you're interested in other girls...\nI'll discipline you with all kinds of techniques —\nthe triangle horse, the turtle tie~.
Today I'll be your personal maid,\nso let's go around the school festival together~.
M-My own personal...!!
Th-Th-Then... may I hold your hand?\nHah hah hah...
H-Hey!!\nWhat're you doin'~!!!
Huh? My personal... maid...?
What're you talkin' about~.\nGross~.
Passin' out after eatin' my 'My Beloved,\nIn My Hands Bowl' — there's rude\nand then there's rude~.
Seems I need to teach your body\nhow to treat a lady~.
Pick one: the 'triangle horse'\nor the 'turtle tie'~!!
Now! Choose~!!
Uwaaah, I'm sorry, I'm sorry,\nI'm sooorry.
